content.text: {"openings":[{"text":"Ada found the feather flag raised in the clocktower window, but the neighbor below was asleep. “Our noisy first meeting may wake the whole staircase,” she whispered. Pip tucked his wings around his sneeze. The new club had an invitation, a bell, and one very drowsy audience member.","when":[{"key":"flag.color","op":"eq","value":"blue","at":"initial"},{"key":"neighbor.awake","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"initial"},{"key":"ada.promise.noisy","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"initial"}]},{"text":"A red feather waved above the clocktower door. Ada mistook it for a welcome sign and bounced up the stairs with the club ribbon. “We need a beginning with a bonk!” she announced. Pip grinned at the awake neighbor’s window, while Mr. Bellweather reached for his wooden key.","when":[{"key":"flag.color","op":"eq","value":"red","at":"initial"},{"key":"neighbor.awake","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"initial"},{"key":"ada.promise.noisy","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"initial"},{"key":"pip.believes.sneeze_loud","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"initial"}]},{"text":"Pip stared at the brass bell as if it were a dragon-sized sneeze. He was sure any chime would boom horribly, even though Ada promised a splendid club meeting. “Perhaps the bell has a tiny voice,” said Mr. Bellweather, jingling the key. “Perhaps I have a tiny nose,” said Pip, hopeful and horrified.","when":[{"key":"flag.color","op":"eq","value":"red","at":"initial"},{"key":"neighbor.awake","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"initial"},{"key":"pip.believes.sneeze_loud","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"initial"}]}],"scenes":[{"scene":"notice_flag","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada leaned beneath the dusty gears and discovered that the feather flag was blue. “Blue means mystery!” she said, while its tail tickled her ear.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"keeper_explains_flag","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mr. Bellweather tapped the flagpole. “That signal means the tower is being aired out, not that a club guest has arrived.” Ada’s eyebrows hopped upward. “So the ribbon must do the inviting!”","when":[]}]},{"scene":"ada_tells_pip_flag","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Ada passed the flag’s true meaning to Pip, who stopped preparing his most enormous entrance sneeze.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"notice_neighbor","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada peered through the stairwell window and discovered whether the neighbor was awake. She pressed one finger to her lips, then tucked the club ribbon safely under her elbow.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"ada_tells_pip_neighbor","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Ada whispered the window news to Pip. His frill folded or sprang up, but his claws stayed politely away from the bell rope.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"inspect_soft_rope","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip tugged the short rope beside the bell and discovered it was the soft practice rope: the brass bell gave a little spoon-in-a-teacup ting. “That is not a roar,” he breathed. “That is a very polite ding.”","when":[]}]},{"scene":"hand_over_invitation","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Once Pip understood the flag was no invitation, Ada handed Mr. Bellweather the red ribbon, its two tails swishing like tiny flags.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"deliver_invitation","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mr. Bellweather carried the ribbon to the tower door and delivered the invitation. “Clocktower Club begins now,” he declared. Ada opened her mouth to cheer, then remembered the sleeping staircase and made a silent cheer instead.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"prepare_notebook","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada opened the club notebook on a crate. Pip drew a dragon wearing a bell for a hat, and Mr. Bellweather set a dusty gear beside the page as the club’s first meeting table.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"lend_key","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"With the notebook ready, Mr. Bellweather placed the wooden key in Pip’s warm claw. “Keeper of the beginning,” he said.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"unlock_bell","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip turned the key. The bell’s latch clicked open, revealing two ropes: one thick and grand, one short and soft. Pip stared at the soft rope as if it had just winked.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"choose_gentle","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip chose the short rope. “A tiny chime can still be brave,” he said. Ada squeezed his shoulder, and his sneeze hid behind a gear until it felt ready to behave.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"choose_grand","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip chose the thick rope for a grand beginning. “Stand back!” he cried. Ada grabbed the notebook, Mr. Bellweather grabbed his hat, and Pip grabbed the rope with a grin wide enough to hold three cupcakes.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"perform_gentle_meeting","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The three club members performed their first meeting around the crate. Pip pulled the soft rope, and the bell gave one golden blink—small, clear, and proud enough to make the dusty gears listen.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"perform_grand_meeting","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The three club members performed their first meeting. Pip pulled the thick rope, and the bell made one enormous BONK that sent a puff of dust dancing through the clocktower like gray confetti.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"neighbor_pleased","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The awake neighbor climbed the stairs carrying three sleepy muffins. “That little chime is lovely,” they said. Pip bowed so quickly that his tail knocked the crate, and Ada caught the notebook before it sneezed off the edge.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"neighbor_quiet","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The neighbor stayed asleep, but the quiet meeting stirred no eyelids. Ada, Pip, and Mr. Bellweather leaned together in a whispering circle while the tiny bell sound curled gently up the stairs.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"neighbor_amused","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The awake neighbor laughed at the enormous bonk. Mr. Bellweather laughed too, and Pip’s proud grin became a startled grin when one loose feather floated down onto his nose.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"neighbor_startled","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The neighbor woke with a startled grin and peered into the tower. “Was that the club?” they asked. Pip nodded, clutching the rope. “The very first meeting,” Ada said, as dust sparkled around them.","when":[]}]}],"endings":[{"text":"Ada wrote the club’s name in the notebook while three sleepy muffins cooled beside the page. Above them, Pip’s tiny chime trembled once more, like a bright little secret that had decided to stay.","when":[{"key":"notebook.meeting_done","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"},{"key":"bell.last_sound","op":"eq","value":"soft","at":"after"},{"key":"neighbor.response","op":"eq","value":"pleased","at":"after"}]},{"text":"The notebook lay open beneath the gears, and the neighbor’s laughter still bounced among the clock hands. Pip wore his grand-bell grin like a crown, though a feather remained stuck to his nose.","when":[{"key":"notebook.meeting_done","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"},{"key":"bell.last_sound","op":"eq","value":"grand","at":"after"},{"key":"neighbor.response","op":"eq","value":"amused","at":"after"}]},{"text":"The new club’s name curled across the notebook page. Beside it, the sleeping neighbor breathed on, while Pip’s gentle bell gave the tower one small golden blink and Ada’s ribbon tails settled like red smiles.","when":[{"key":"notebook.meeting_done","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"},{"key":"bell.last_sound","op":"eq","value":"soft","at":"after"},{"key":"neighbor.response","op":"eq","value":"quiet","at":"after"}]},{"text":"The notebook shook beneath the enormous bell’s last echo. The neighbor stood blinking in the doorway, Pip held the rope, and Ada’s red ribbon fluttered bravely in the dusty golden air.","when":[{"key":"notebook.meeting_done","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"},{"key":"bell.last_sound","op":"eq","value":"grand","at":"after"},{"key":"neighbor.response","op":"eq","value":"startled","at":"after"}]}],"lexicon":[]}
